Talking about the safety tech that Maruti Suzuki has added to the new Ignis, it now comes equipped with Electronic Stability Program (ESP) and hill hold assist across all variants. Other safety features continue as is.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWhat are the engine, performance, and specifications of the Ignis?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eThe hatchback now comes with an RDE-compliant, 1.2-litre, four-cylinder petrol engine.
